initialStatePolicy.mismatchHandling: bind every node independently; never substitute another node's current or rollback tuple

failClosedFindings: preflight does not bind each node's current binary and manifest device, inode, owner, mode, nlink, bytes and SHA
fresh rollback captures the binary but not the node's current manifest as one prewrite pair
a later-node failure does not roll back previously promoted nodes in reverse order
post-restart verification checks only status availability and binary SHA, not sampled status, node identity and peer readiness semantics
the executor cannot prove global completion false after a partially promoted four-node attempt

forwardPhases: re-read exact service, current binary and current manifest tuples
fail before write on any tuple drift, missing file, future inode substitution or unexpected nlink
create no-clobber root-owned fresh binary and manifest backups from that node's current bytes
read back fresh backup tuples and require byte-for-byte SHA and size equality
create no-clobber candidate stage and verify bundle, binary and manifest identities
atomically install candidate binary and manifest without changing unit, environment, validator identity or chain state
restart ynx-chaind once and perform one sampled-time health, status, nodeIdentity and peerSync readback
require candidate build identity and fail-closed ready-validator semantics before advancing

phases: re-read live candidate tuple and fresh backup tuple at rollback boundary
fail closed rather than delete or overwrite if either tuple drifted
atomically restore that node's exact prewrite manifest then binary
read back service and all four loopback endpoints at one sampled time
require exact prewrite build identity and preserve backup plus terminal evidence

forbiddenMutations: use of one node's rollback tuple on another node
deletion of backup, stage or terminal evidence during the execution lease
